newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Tadiran Tel gets Sri Lanka Telecom deal.
newsitem.headline: Tadiran Tel gets Sri Lanka Telecom deal.

text.p: Israel's Tadiran Telecommunications Ltd said on Sunday it had signed a contract worth about $15 million with Sri Lanka Telecom for the supply of MultiGain Wireless systems.
Tadiran said the systems would enable Sri Lanka Telecom to cope with urgent demand and provide advanced telephony services to subscribers in urban, suburban and remote locations.

"Sri Lanka Telecom selected the MultiGain Wireless system because of its quality and its capability to adapt within a short time to the specific operational requirements of the company," said Haim Rosen, Tadiran Tel's president and CEO.
Tadiran Telecommunications is a subsidiary of Tadiran Ltd.
